newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps raises NYNEX ratings.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps raises NYNEX ratings.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said it raised its ratings on NYNEX Corp and reaffirmed ratings of Bell Atlantic Corp in anticipation of their previously announced merger.
Duff said it raised NYNEX Capital Funding medium-term notes to A-plus from A, and raised NYNEX Corp's debentures to A-plus from A and its commercial paper to D-1-plus from D-1.
NYNEX Credit Co's medium term notes were raised to A-plus from A and its commercial paper was rated D-1.
Duff also reaffirmed Bell Atlantic Financial Services senior unsecured debt at double-A and its commercial paper at D-1-plus.

"The Bell Atlantic and NYNEX parent ratings reflect expected financial performance for the consolidated, post-merger Bell Atlantic that is solidly in the (single-A-plus) rating category," Duff said. "Following the merger, recent improvements in financial performance are expected to continue, particularly as operating synergies are realized."
